title: Checkout retry ledger rehearsal
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Retry checkout after response loss; select the ledger showing one correct order.

sourceContract.readme: Checkout/order submission: Produce one order with the correct result despite retries or routing changes.
sourceContract.backlog: Add synthetic checkout/order submission with response-loss and retry controls.
sourceContract.acceptance: Exactly one intended order/effect is recorded with a correct client result or explicit unresolved failure.
sourceContract.portableCard: Retry checkout after response loss; select the ledger showing one correct order.
sourceContract.nativeSibling: Conduct one synthetic checkout transition; verify real effect counts and honest unresolved outcomes.
sourceContract.journeyIsolation: Use isolated fixtures or appropriate sandboxes for journeys involving external side effects.

packetContract.creditLimit: One original A-S134 frozen-S credit, parent acceptance only; no added test, repair, proof or refinement credits.

preconditions: Every checkout, order, payment marker, effect, key, acknowledgement, response, identity, route and state observation is fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY.
No actual payment, business, user-data, network or database operation occurs.
One fixed intention uses CHECKOUT-DEMO-01, CLIENT-DEMO-01, CART-DEMO-01, KEY-DEMO-01, ORDER-DEMO-01, EFFECT-DEMO-01 and PAYMENT-DEMO-01.
The first missing acknowledgement leaves the first effect outcome unknown at the response-loss boundary.
Seven alternative ledgers are separate fictional comparisons, not cumulative orders.
Missing acknowledgement is neither failure nor success nor permission for a duplicate order.
actions: Load the fixed response-loss DATA with the exact checkout token.
Reveal the fictional retry comparison; no order or payment is submitted.
Inspect all linked order/effect/payment-marker records, keys, identity/state, acknowledgements and responses.
Select one exact ledger ID and measure positive, negative or unknown results.
Repeat up to four runs/sixteen actions with all earlier results retained.
Explicitly reset only this page's in-memory rehearsal.
assertions: Load, retry and inspect must precede selection; none alone measures or certifies an effect.
kept-key alone demonstrates one matching order/effect/payment marker with a correct acknowledged client result.
fresh-key shows two orders/effects/payment markers; attempt counts and a synthetic 200 do not certify one correct order.
wrong-response, lost-state and wrong-identity detect independently incorrect client, cart or identity results.
unacknowledged has one known correct order but an unresolved client result; unobserved retains null counts, not zeros.
The source acceptance's explicit unresolved failure is represented as an unresolved client outcome, never inferred order failure or success.
Original response-loss interruption and initially unknown observations remain even after later positive recovery.
Exact typed records, allowlists, descriptors, ordered replay and fixed budgets reject coercion, getters, forged observations/results and out-of-order actions without mutation.
All four results and sixteen actions remain; a seventeenth action needs explicit reset.
Native labels, Tab/Enter/Space, focus, alerts, stage guards, prototype-based form reset and model-resource failure are observed in actual Edge DOM.
Actual CSP blocks inline script, eval, inline style, connect, image, frame and form operations without network or unsafe flags.
Normal verification is read-only; only exact CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 deliberately creates new exclusive raw browser JSON.

nativeRemainder.blocker: Approved isolated synthetic native checkout target, CORE/DATA/HOST, D-S049 parent dependency and independent real effect/client evidence remain unavailable. No payment, business or user-data authorization is inferred.
nativeRemainder.requiredEvidence: One intended order/effect under actual approved response loss/retry/routing, correct client result or explicit unresolved outcome, identity/state/key observations, bounded retry contract, retained unknowns and cleanup.

limits: No payment, order submission, business/user data, network, database, cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity, credentials, deployment, spend, packages, framework, downloads, unsafe flags or foreground leases.
All domain observations are fixed fictional DATA; browser DOM behavior and local test results are the only actual execution evidence.
No native B-S134 proof, original D-S134 acceptance, Node.js 24 production validation, reliability guarantee or universal continuity.
Published isolated helper has known unattended context/page/cleanup lifecycle limitations; the inactive recovery prototype is unqualified.
Only learning\S134 is owned; C005-C008, local-harness integration, root/shared files, source README and ledgers are not edited.
Parent alone accepts A-S134 once; zero extra test, repair, proof or refinement credits.
